note: ADR-030: Spring-layer DUB packages (the Spring Framework API and the third-party APIs of rulebook R1) live under framework/<artifact>, outside the 37 engine packages of policy/packages.json, and move to flint-framework at the repo split. tools/gates.py (framework_layers) checks each against this file. 'licence' is the module's own licence: EPL-2.0 modules hold ported EPL-2.0 sources and nothing else (ADR-030 section 7). 'also' lists further package roots a module owns beside 'module' (spring-tx is flint.dao and flint.transaction).

engine-jpa.upstream: Flint's generated Jakarta Persistence mapping adapter (ADR-034)

engine-jdbc.upstream: Flint's own JDBC driver over flint.engine.sql (docs/spring/phase1/data-access.md)

postgresql.upstream: PgJDBC's org.postgresql.Driver as Flint's driver declaration (Flint's own, over flint.engine.jdbc)

sqlite-jdbc.upstream: sqlite-jdbc's org.sqlite.JDBC as Flint's driver declaration (Flint's own, over flint.engine.jdbc)

engine-servlet.upstream: Flint servlet container over flint:engine-web (docs/spring/phase1/web-mvc.md, Real HTTP serving)
